acceptanceCriteria: An ID-scoped export touches only the requested artifact and required indexes.
An unchanged projection is not rewritten.
Full export requires an explicit all-records option and reports its scope.
componentsAffected: Provide ID-scoped Markdown projection export and make every export write only content whose bytes changed.
testSteps: Regression tests covering scoped export, no-op export, and explicit full export.

workItem.title: Add scoped and idempotent Markdown projection export
